description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). One live request to a URL with no redirect following: up or down (and why: DNS, timeout, refused, TLS), status, Location, timings in ms for DNS, TCP connect, TLS handshake, time to first byte and total, IP, HTTP version, server header. Measured from Malaysia. Never cached. ~0.1-2 s.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: http_ping
title: HTTP ping: up or down, status and timings (DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB)
